description: Create a Pulse alert channel. Free. Pass exactly one of emails, webhook_url, slack_webhook_url or pagerduty_routing_key. A check alerts a channel once the channel's id is in the check's channel_ids.

dry_run.description: Preview the action without executing it. Returns what would happen, including cost estimates. Always dry-run first for anything that costs money.

pagerduty_routing_key.description: PagerDuty channel: an Events API v2 integration key

slack_webhook_url.description: Slack channel: a Slack incoming webhook URL

webhook_secret.description: Webhook channel: an optional secret used to sign each delivery

webhook_url.description: Webhook channel: the URL each alert is POSTed to as JSON

name: edge_create_pulse_channel
